_comment: Copy to .claude/rechain.json in your Laravel project. Keys marked optional may be null. These are pcdrama.com's values.
_ssh_host: ssh alias for production; an alias, never a hostname with credentials
_remote_path: directory on the production host that holds artisan
_blog_path: URL prefix in front of the slug on both hosts
_status: status_column and published_value may be null when every row is live
_meta: any of the six columns above may be null; the generator only swaps the ones present
_storage_dir: git-ignored; one subdirectory per slug holds prod-row.json, before.html, draft.html, chain-edits.php
_widgets_config: optional: a config file keyed by slug whose rows carry anchors a rewrite must keep matching; null to skip
_ledger_path: optional: JSON list of past rewrites by slug; null to skip
_stop_reason_class: optional: a class with static stopReason(string $slug, string $content): ?string; null to skip
